live_observation.pattern: The same visible Writing Block repeatedly alternated between WRITING_BLOCK_LOCAL_BODY_UNAVAILABLE / payload_bytes=0 and payload_extracted=true / payload_bytes=2447. Each non-empty observation restarted PROMPT_DOM_STABILITY_STARTED; no command reached the Worker before the operator interrupted the loop.
live_observation.repetition: The same empty -> non-empty -> stability restart pattern continued for more than one minute until a manual user turn interrupted polling.

exact_v141_code_chain: confirmLocalWritingBlockCopyAndExtract() re-resolves the Writing Block and extracts its local DOM body
when extraction is empty/unavailable, PROMPT_EMPTY_WRITING_BLOCK_IGNORED executes
that branch sets candidateFirstSeen = null and schedules another prompt check
on the next non-empty observation, !candidateFirstSeen forces structuralChanged=true
PROMPT_DOM_STABILITY_STARTED restarts the two-second structural gate from zero
the live renderer can become locally unreadable again at/after the gate, returning to the empty branch
there is no terminal budget for this empty/non-empty oscillation, so the cycle can repeat indefinitely
root_cause: Transient Writing Block local-body unavailability is treated as a full loss of candidate stability. Resetting candidateFirstSeen to null couples payload extraction failure back into the structural-stability gate and creates an unbounded restart loop.
historical_origin_boundary: The same candidateFirstSeen=null empty-payload branch is present in exact v1.0.34 and remains present in exact v1.0.41. Exact authority is insufficient to claim it first appeared before v1.0.34.

supersedes.reason: The earlier screenshot-based record correctly captured a hang and a secondary structural-signature risk, but only labeled button churn as a high-confidence candidate pending signature evidence. The live journal now provides a more direct causal chain: local-body availability oscillation itself resets candidateFirstSeen and restarts the gate.

secondary_risk_not_currently_proven_as_t: writingBlockStructuralSignature still incorporates every assistant-section button snapshot, so unrelated assistant controls can perturb structural_signature. This remains a separate regression target but is not required to explain the observed live loop.

rule_implications.rule_7: Previous screenshot-only causal claim was premature; corrected by this evidence-backed chain.
rule_implications.rule_15: FAIL in v1.0.41 capture path: the oscillation has no terminal condition.
rule_implications.rule_16: FAIL in existing regression authority: current tests did not reproduce the live empty/non-empty body oscillation.

patch_boundary: No runtime patch is authorized by this evidence alone. Extend the full Rule-20 audit through v1.0.41 and add an exact-v1.0.41 RED reproducing intermittent local-body unavailability. Keep proxy/IP recovery as a separate state-machine issue.
